description: Two create-time-only defects in the tracked record of the 0.3 cutover, both confirmed by execution on 2026-08-01. (1) migrate-hosted-tracker-db-to-todo-db-0-3-schema still carries the must-preserve 'the hosted DB is never restored with --replace while another actor holds a live claim'. That precondition is SUPERSEDED - a claim check is not a gate, because create/defer/promote/block/drop and config writes take no claim at all (root@vm emitted 21 unclaimed create/drop events in under 4 minutes on 2026-08-01). The block reason says so; the must-preserve row still says the wrong thing, and must-preserve is create-time-only. That item has 5 dependents whose dep edges are also create-time-only, so drop+recreate cascades into re-creating all five - do NOT drop it casually; either accept the cascade deliberately or land update-scope-rules in the todo-db project first. (2) Rung 1 of tracker-cutover-needs-a-write-freeze-not-a-claim-check shells out to 'todo stats --json', which does not exist; the command exits 2, both reads capture empty stdout, and '' == '' passes the rung UNCONDITIONALLY. Executed verbatim against production on 2026-08-01 it exited 0 ('no writer is active') while the event count moved 4534 to 4538 during the very 60s window it was measuring. stats['events'] (added by #1377) makes a correct probe writable. Decisions and runbook are recorded in _project/decisions/todo-db-cutover-write-freeze-2026-08-01.md (D2: SCHEMA_VERSION stays 4, the freeze stays advisory; D3: freeze + verified quiescence, neither alone).
